user.title: Set up wa:sh – 1/3
user.description: Connects the wa:sh app to Home Assistant. Next you'll get a pairing code for the app.

data_description.name: Used as area and title, e.g. “Laundry room”.

expired.title: Code expired
expired.description: No phone paired within 10 minutes. **Submit** creates a new code.

progress.pair:
Enter this code in the wa:sh app:

# {code}

**App:** Menu → My programs → Home Assistant → enter the address and the code, tap **Pair**.

This window waits and continues automatically once the phone is paired. The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.

create_entry.default:

The phone now reports to **{name}**. Washer and dryer show up as devices of their own.

Pair another phone via **Configure** on the entry.
